services.desc: Valentines Sunset Cruise Looking for a romantic and relaxing outing, while enjoying the evening sunset? Our Valentine Sunset Cruise is a perfect start or end to your special Valentine’s weekend. We have popular San Diego guitarist and musician, Joseph Angelastro playing live music during each Valentine Sunset Cruises. Cruise also includes a complimentary glass of champagne.
